scope: Single-model conditional CPU_ONLY full pipeline versus qualified baseline; qualification must pass first
decision_rule: All96 scores exact; allrequests disposed; allqualified identities/guards unchanged; >=10% median decode reduction in eachprefix and pooled; no perprefix median prefill regression>10%. Report round variability and host telemetry.
isolation: Fresh sequential subprocess per arm slot; exactly one loaded full pipeline; no concurrent native model/GPU/benchmark jobs.
timing: Synchronous Pipeline.forward only; normal32token prefill chunking included. Load/verification, statecreation/disposal, IO, host telemetry and equality checks excluded.
sampling: Teacher forced fixed qualified prompt+674reference token stream; no RNG or candidate-dependent token choices.
